title: Spool reader cursor
description: Designed (docs/native/capture-split.md 4.1, #773), not implemented. `cursor.app.json` in the spool directory: what the reader (the app) has handled. Written by the reader only, with tmp + rename, at most once a second and at stop, and only after a handler returned. Capture reads it to delete what is done; it never writes it. "Done" means the row exists and the reader holds its own hard link to the audio.

spool_epoch.description: The spool the cursor belongs to (the EPOCH file). Against another spool it counts for nothing: the reader starts from 0.

seq.description: Every item with a `seq` at or below this is done. 0: none yet.

done.description: Up to 256 `seq` values above `seq` that finished out of order (channels are handled in parallel), each once.

tries.description: How often an item not yet done has been handed to its handler: {seq as decimal digits: tries}. After 3 the reader quarantines the item and moves past it.

at.description: When the cursor was written, Unix seconds.
